why: RSG runners reset constantly and only keep spawns that give fast early resources: wood for tools, and a fast portal (village, ruined portal, beach with buried treasure and magma ravines). With no trees in sight there is no wood for a crafting table or pickaxe, and with no water, lava or structure there is no route to a portal. Walking around to look for any of these costs minutes, while a reset costs seconds, so the expected time of a new seed is far better.
trap: Keep and walk until trees appear. The run is not lost, but the expected time is far worse than resetting.

techniques.description: Reset spawns with no early resources or portal route within view.
techniques.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minecraft_speedrunning (section on resetting; raw wikitext line 48, fetched 2026-11-06) says runners reset to find villages, ruined portals or beaches; a runner guide quote for 'no trees = reset' is still needed (mcsr.info blocked from sandbox).

sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minecraft_speedrunning (section on resetting; raw wikitext line 48, fetched 2026-11-06)

answer.reasoning: No wood means no tools; reset is cheaper than exploring.

alternates.why_valid: Same decision with different reasoning; reasoning is not scored.

broken.why_wrong: Commits minutes to a spawn with no wood and no portal route.
